title: Urban decay / drug zone
content: Have you been here? When you take one of the freeway off-ramps on one side of the airport it leads to a section of the city that has been destroyed / abandoned and is in ruins. There are many camps of homeless people and throughout the area is an open-air drug market overseen by a drug cartel. Mostly people selling some kind of narcotics, sometimes called Z, which is similar to fentanyl. In my most recent visit there was a large tent that one of the narcos was selling his wares. They were also branding all of the addicts with the cartel logo on their wrists. I was working with a group trying to deliver harm reduction medical aid to the population. There are also drones flying in the area. While most of the city complex is quite beautiful and advanced this region is totally destroyed.
